meta.title: A party game of secrets, clues and missions
meta.description: Secrets is a mobile-first realtime party game. Build teams, run secret missions, trade clues and buzz your friends from every phone, with a big-screen dashboard for the room.

screens.title: One game, two screens
screens.subtitle: Every player uses their phone for private clues, missions and buzzes. One shared screen sets the scene for the room.

phone.title: In your pocket
phone.body: Your secret, your wallet, your missions and every buzz—big buttons, no clutter, nothing the room can see.

tv.title: On the big screen
tv.body: Cast the dashboard to a TV or laptop for live rounds, house balances, dramatic clue drops and face-offs—safe for everyone to watch.

how.title: How a game night runs
how.subtitle: Set up in a minute, play for an evening.

steps.title: Create a game
steps.body: Pick Quick Night, Weekend or a custom round schedule and set the starting cash.

steps.title: Share one link
steps.body: Invite friends by email—one join link, gated by your guest list.

steps.title: Everyone joins on their phone
steps.body: Players get a secret, a team and a wallet. Open the dashboard on the TV.

steps.title: Play the rounds
steps.body: Investigate, run missions, trade clues, buzz accusations and settle Share/Steal dilemmas.

items.title: Made for phones
items.body: Big controls, private clues and buzzes in everyone’s pocket.

items.title: A big-screen dashboard
items.body: A dramatic, spoiler-safe screen built for the room.

items.title: Live game updates
items.body: Rounds, balances and reveals stay perfectly in sync.

items.title: Secrets, clues & missions
items.body: Private or shared secrets, text and image hint decks, and host-judged missions.

items.title: Wallets & a fair ledger
items.body: Personal and team wallets backed by an immutable, balanced ledger.

items.title: Buzzes & dilemmas
items.body: Accusation buzzes, paid hint buzzes and simultaneous Share/Steal team dilemmas.

formats.title: Pick a format
formats.subtitle: The format sets the economy and the round schedule. Fine-tune everything later.

items.name: Quick Night
items.flow: Team investigation → Solo investigation → House Secret → Finale.

items.name: Weekend
items.flow: Team and solo investigations, a surprise event, nominations and a finale.

items.name: Custom
items.flow: Add, reorder and duplicate team, solo, event, nomination, elimination and finale rounds.

fair.title: Friendly by design
items: No real money—every balance is in-game play cash.
A zero balance or a revealed secret never knocks you out.
Only a host-added elimination round can change who’s still in play.
The host adjudicates missions and can reverse mistakes, with reasons on record.

items.q: What do I need to play?
items.body: A phone each and one shared screen—a TV or a laptop—for the dashboard. No downloads.
It’s built for a room of friends, roughly 4 to 16, split into teams.

items.q: How long does a game take?
items.body: Quick Night runs around 45 minutes; Weekend fills a whole evening.
Never. All wallets use in-game cash and there are no transfers between players.

items.q: Do I need to prepare secrets in advance?
items.body: No. Players with no secret of their own are dealt one from a pack, so you can start right away.

cta.title: Gather your friends. Keep your secrets.
cta.body: Set up a game in a minute and send the link.
